Leah (CS): Quick heads-up 1: Solstice Health QBR prep next Thursday. They've seen a spike in embedding calls after a UI tweak. Need a tight spend forecast + a mitigation plan for renewal talks.
Sam (FinOps): I can do a 3-scenario forecast: baseline, commit-sensitivity, and burst tail (99th). Want it split by route (embeddings/chat) and by MAU cohort?
Diego (Onboarding): They rolled out client-side batching but not server-side prefix caching. That explains the embeddings delta. I have a small checklist to reduce calls ~40% if they enable route-level prefixing.
Mina (Eval): If we aim to swap to embed-small-quant for non-critical vectors, I can run a tolerability test on 100 dev queries. Need permission to flag any regressions >10%.
Rae (AM): Customer's ask: predictable monthly spend and an option for a 12-month commit with graded discounts. They'll accept up to 10% drop in embedding recall for lower cost, but not for chat.
Leah (CS): Concrete asks for QBR deck: 1) spend forecast CSV (Sam) 2) quick cost-savings playbook (Diego) 3) eval summary + sample diffs (Mina) 4) alerting & rollback plan (billing-bot). Who owns the alerts?
Sam (FinOps): @billing-bot can you provision two alerts: monthly_warning at 65% of proposed commit -> email + #cs-ops; and emergency_route at 95% that auto-routes 15% traffic to lower-cost route? Add per-route token burn view.
billing-bot: Created alerts: Solstice_monthly_65 (notify #cs-ops + rae@redwood.com). Emergency rule Solstice_95 will trigger auto-route: embeddings -> embed-small-quant at 15% traffic.
Diego (Onboarding): Canary command for staging (rdwctl): ```rdwctl configure solstice --route embeddings batch_size=256 prefix_cache=true cache_ttl=43200``` Will run perf + observed token delta.
Mina (Eval): Eval plan: 100 embedding queries + 20 human checks for recall. Metrics: avg cosine drop, recall@10, and pass_rate. Deliverable: short markdown with sample diffs by EOD tomorrow.
Rae (AM): Negotiation note: propose commit tiers (monthly tokens): 40M (5% discount), 80M (12% discount), 200M (22% discount) and include a 2-month grace credit if they exceed by <10% in any month during first quarter.
Leah (CS): Ops runbook snippets for the slide: "If spend > 85% of commit and latency < SLO, enable 10% fallthrough to embed-small-quant and notify AM/CS." and "If cache hit rate < 35% revert client SDK change and open onboarding ticket."
Sam (FinOps): Sample of forecast CSV (head):
route,30d_tokens,baseline_monthly_est,commit_40M_est,commit_80M_est,99pct_tail_est
embeddings,28,38000000,36000000,32000000,59000000
chat,5,6000000,5500000,5200000,11000000
(Full CSV will be shared in GDrive.)
Diego (Onboarding): I'll attach the k8s rdw config snippet after the staging run. Also adding a short play: "Enable server-side batching and prefix cache keys per customer namespace."
Mina (Eval): Quick headline for slides: "embed-small-quant reduces cost by ~30% on embeddings with median recall drop ~6%. Chat unaffected. Recommend targeted rollout on background indexing only."
Rae (AM): I'll present the commit tiers and the grace-credit option. Also asking legal to draft rollback clause for quality regressions >10% during trial.
Leah (CS): Action items recap: Sam -> full CSV + scenario breakdown by EOD. Diego -> canary results + config. Mina -> eval doc + sample diffs. Rae -> term sheet draft + renewal window. billing-bot -> ensure alerts in place and include the dashboard link.
billing-bot: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/alerts/solstice (shared with #cs-ops).
Leah (CS): Thanks all. I'll start the deck and post the first draft in #qbr-deck for review. Ping in thread if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
